info.title: Istravex API
info.description: Read-only access to the Istravex corpus: fixtures, their raw XDR, the canonical ledgers they were verified against, and the kit's results. Also hosts a mock Stellar RPC that replays the corpus for any RPC-backed indexer.

get.description: Liveness and the build the server is running. Never cached.
The headline numbers: fixtures, SDK checks, provenance checks, golden frames, the wallet-backend pilot and CAP coverage.

Returns one XDR value from the fixture, base64 by default (exactly as stored in the repository), or raw bytes with `encoding=binary`. `X-XDR-Type` names the XDR type and `X-Content-SHA256` is the sha256 of the decoded bytes, matching the manifest.

The full `LedgerCloseMeta` a fixture was verified against, as a zstd-compressed `LedgerCloseMetaBatch` (the layout of SDF's public data lake). `X-Content-SHA256` is the sha256 of the decompressed XDR.

The raw output of one kit stage, exactly as committed in `corpus/results/`: SDK runs (`javascript`, `go`, `rust`), golden checks (`goldens-*`), `provenance`, `replay` and `pilot-wallet-backend`. 64-bit integers are JSON strings.
Every live CAP (Final or Implemented) from the pinned stellar-protocol checkout, whether it changes XDR, and which fixtures cover it.

Every finding the kit has produced or reproduced: the affected component, severity, upstream issue, the minimal corpus entries that show it, and the failing checks it explains. Each failure the kit reproduces on purpose (an SDK release before a fix, a wallet-backend commit before a fix) maps to one of these. The same file as corpus/findings.json.

severity_scale.critical: Consensus, funds or keys at risk.
severity_scale.high: Ingestion halts, or value is attributed to the wrong account.
severity_scale.medium: Data is silently lost or wrong (an amount, an ID, a missing record), or a valid network value is rejected on a common path.
severity_scale.low: A valid but rare value is rejected or mishandled; tooling or test infrastructure is affected.
severity_scale.info: Behaviour worth knowing about that isn't a defect.

post.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 with the wire shapes of Stellar RPC. Supports `getHealth`, `getNetwork`, `getLatestLedger` and `getLedgers` (cursor paging over the corpus's sparse ledgers). Point an RPC-backed indexer at `https://rpc.istravex.com/{network}` to replay the corpus. Batches of up to 20 requests; bodies up to 64 KB.
